transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. How can I help you today?
Hello, Dr. Smith. I've been feeling extremely down and depressed, and I have lost interest in almost everything I used to enjoy. This has been going on for about eight months now.
Have you felt this way most of the day, more days than not, for at least two years, or is it closer to several months?
It has definitely been closer to several months rather than two years. I've been feeling this way almost every day for about eight months now.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "anhedonia",
  "question": "Have you also been experiencing a lack of pleasure or interest in activities you once enjoyed, even when you try to do them?"
Yes, I've completely lost interest in the hobbies I used to love. Even when I force myself to try them, I feel absolutely no pleasure, happiness, or satisfaction anymore.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "sleep",
  "question": "Have you been having trouble sleeping, such as difficulty falling asleep, waking up frequently, or waking up too early and not being able to go back to sleep?"
No, I haven't really had any major issues with my sleep. My sleep patterns haven't changed significantly, and I seem to be sleeping about the same as I usually do.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "appetite",
  "question": "Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently, such as eating much more or much less than usual?"
Yes, I've noticed a big change. My appetite has decreased significantly almost every day, and I've lost a lot of weight over the last few months without even trying to diet.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "guilt",
  "question": "Have you been feeling excessive guilt, worthlessness, or self-blame, even about things that wouldn't normally bother you?"

Yes, I've been feeling completely worthless lately and carry a deep sense of guilt all the time. I constantly blame myself and keep replaying minor mistakes from my past, feeling responsible for things that shouldn't really bother me.
